requirement: Corrected full-galaxy Phase 4C completed independently
evidence: Immutable final receipt with start/end, phase results, signer/hash, final DB size, peak filesystem, runtime, WAL, and environment identity
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: all required fields present and receipt hash verified; fail: partial, edited, historical-run, or unknown result

requirement: Phase 4C input and toolchain identity matches approved pins
evidence: Receipt for source artifact name/bytes/SHA, baseline SHA, importer composite SHA, normalizer SHA, PG version/settings, generation key
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: every value exactly matches the approved wrapper pins or an explicitly re-approved input; fail: any mismatch/unexplained value

requirement: Exact preserved database is identified and quiescent
evidence: Two independent captures of system_identifier, database OID/name, timeline, checkpoint LSN, checksums, writer sessions/processes
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: captures agree and only approved hardening writers exist; fail: identity drift, missing capture, or unexpected writer

requirement: Full source reconciliation and validation passed
evidence: Source-run/generation-input ledger, counts/hashes, rejection/quarantine summary, invariant suite, immutable validation receipt
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: all source coverage reconciles and every mandatory invariant passes with explained bounded rejection; fail: unexplained loss/mismatch/unknown

requirement: Canonical publish and rollback are atomic and read back correctly
evidence: Phase 4C publication/rollback transaction, pointer/audit/outbox rows, API/direct-SQL readback, retained rollback generation
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: one current READY generation, atomic audit/outbox, rollback and re-publish read back exact IDs; fail: partial/mixed/unknown state

requirement: Immutable promotion identity bundle exists
evidence: Canonical JSON envelope and hash covering database, generation, inputs, validation, backup, configuration, OpenAPI/frontend identities
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: complete, reproducible hash stored locally and protected off-host; fail: generation-only label, missing identity, or mutable-only copy

requirement: Candidate state is append-only and does not rewrite rehearsal/canonical history
evidence: Promotion event chain showing FULL_REHEARSAL_NOT_PRODUCTION retained and subsequent candidate states external/control-only
pass_fail_criterion: Pass: event hashes/actors/evidence verify and canonical fingerprints remain equal; fail: relabel/edit of receipt or canonical content

evidence: Signed Data/DB, Security/Identity, Operations/Release, and Product approvals; builder/reviewer identity
